name: The noun of preference (ism al-tafḍīl)
definition: A noun on the pattern afʿal that says one thing has more of a quality than another: akbar, 'greater'.
body: It is made from a three-letter verb that can be compared, on afʿal for the masculine and fuʿlā for the feminine. It is used in three ways: with min after it (akbaru min…), with the article (al-akbaru), or in iḍāfa (akbaru al-qawmi). Where a verb does not allow the pattern, the books put ashaddu or akthar before the maṣdar. The Alfiyya and Qaṭr al-nadā set out when it agrees with its noun and when it does not.
